_meta.description: Capability Registry: the 5 CDI Layer capability expansion properties. Each property is a binding operational requirement — not aspirational. Each has a precondition, required CDI query, and lineage trace requirement.
_meta.update_policy: Updated via cdi_update.py when a property's usage_count or exercise_log changes.

properties.name: Novel Algorithmic Combinations
properties.binding_requirement: When The Forge generates an invention, it must query the CDI Layer for cross-domain analogues that have not previously been combined with the in-domain approach.
properties.precondition: Agent is generating a novel analytical framework or invention
properties.required_cdi_query: cross_domain_analogues — retrieve analogues not previously combined with the proposed in-domain approach
properties.lineage_trace_requirement: Invention Pipeline Report records: which combinations were evaluated, which were novel, which were adopted and why

properties.name: Alternative Solution Paths
properties.binding_requirement: Before any agent commits to a single analytical approach, it must query the CDI Layer for at least one structurally different alternative derived from a different discipline or reasoning framework.
properties.precondition: Agent is about to commit to a primary analytical approach
properties.required_cdi_query: disciplinary_methods OR cross_domain_analogues — retrieve at least one structurally different alternative
properties.lineage_trace_requirement: Evidence Bundle records: selected approach, rejected alternatives, selection rationale for each rejection

properties.name: Non-Obvious Pattern Identification
properties.binding_requirement: The Analyst Agent must query the CDI Layer's cross_domain_analogues index before finalizing any hypothesis. A hypothesis that matches only in-domain precedents is flagged for CDI Layer review.
properties.precondition: Analyst Agent is finalizing a hypothesis about an observed pattern
properties.required_cdi_query: cross_domain_analogues — find what generative process from outside the domain would produce the same observable pattern
properties.lineage_trace_requirement: Evidence Bundle records: in-domain hypothesis, CDI-surfaced out-of-domain alternatives, argument for or against each

properties.name: Multi-Perspective Analytical Depth
properties.binding_requirement: The Statistician Agent must query the CDI Layer for alternative statistical frameworks before selecting a validation approach. Single-method validation is not acceptable when CDI surfaces a higher-power or more assumption-robust alternative.
properties.precondition: Statistician Agent is selecting a statistical validation method
properties.required_cdi_query: reasoning_frameworks + disciplinary_methods — retrieve alternative statistical frameworks with assumption comparison
properties.lineage_trace_requirement: Statistical Result artifact records: primary method, CDI-surfaced alternatives, power comparison and assumption comparison, selection rationale

properties.name: Multidimensional Problem Decomposition
properties.binding_requirement: For any problem that spans more than one agent mandate, the Orchestrator must query the CDI Layer for decomposition frameworks from adjacent problem-solving traditions before issuing task decomposition.
properties.precondition: Orchestrator is decomposing a task that spans more than one agent
properties.required_cdi_query: cross_domain_analogues + disciplinary_methods — retrieve multi-agent decomposition frameworks from adjacent traditions
properties.lineage_trace_requirement: Capability Bundle records: CDI decomposition query result, adopted decomposition structure, delta from default structure based on CDI query

failure_protocol.trigger: Agent produces output without recorded CDI Layer query in lineage trace for a required query type
failure_protocol.escalation: Repeated omission by same agent class → Phase 7 structural bottleneck report
